why_not_options_bidask_first: Options bid/ask depth data is orders of magnitude larger and more expensive. Testing directional signal feasibility first via constituent/futures OHLCV sample provides a high-information, low-cost gate before investing in options depth infrastructure.
why_current_repo_data_is_insufficient: The repository only contains 5-minute index OHLC data (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/SENSEX), which has been exhaustively tested and killed under negative controls in Campaigns V3-V6. Constituent OHLCV and futures OHLCV are not currently present in local storage.
